name: APAC sector radar evidence pack

trigger.expression: market-specific intervals during configured trading hours

steps.action: Read the configured market calendar and stop outside trading windows
Read entitled quotes, benchmark, sector membership, volume and timestamped news
Run topic_radar.py and pack_readiness.py without making causal claims
Write a timestamped evidence pack and draft topic shortlist to a configured local output directory
Optionally send a specifically selected, human-reviewed draft to a configured channel

retry.write_steps: no automatic retry after an ambiguous result

logging: Record source timestamps, gaps, readiness status and the selected topic; never log credentials.
rate_limits: Use provider-specific limits and coalesce repeated symbols.
failure_behavior: Retain the last successful artifact as historical context only; never relabel it as current.
